what: A big English line wider than the screen slides 600px left from 100px on the right while the section passes through the screen (0 when the section head touches the bottom of the screen → 1 when it has fully exited the top). It is not tied directly to scroll — each frame it closes 8% of the remaining gap, so it glides to a stop even after the wheel stops

options.dist: Distance moved left until the panel has fully passed (px), default 600 — negative goes right
options.lerp: Share followed per frame, default .08 — at 1 it locks on instantly
options.[data-fx-part=text]: Text line to move (inside the panel). The panel clips overflow

use: Field One / Field Two / Field Three
note: Following works like the original, taking the same share each frame (rAF), so a higher screen refresh rate catches up slightly faster

from.where: shared.js .lw-flow (first page How We Work and About flowing large text) — original ui.js scroll-text: target 100 − progress × 600, .08 per frame
